description: Additions and alterations to approved planning scheme (planning reference number 443/G/P4) for the demolition of existing buildings and erection of 191 flats, 93 bed hotel (including ancillary restaurant), retail and restaurant units, Thameside path, vehicular access from Goat Wharf, change of use of Peerless Pumps building to a restaurant and managers flat, underground car parking and landscaping by the addition of 42 flats, an additional 53 bedrooms on the hotel and widening of the inter-tidal inlet.
